verdict.rationale: Zapier's own docs say developers can embed its automation directly into their product so users connect apps and run automations 'under your brand', which matches white-label embedding. The Workflow API is positioned to power a built-in automation experience or integration marketplace. The evidence is brief marketing-level statements, not in-depth implementation docs. missing for 10: detailed embedding/white-label implementation docs (UI components, branding/theming controls, customer account and auth model, limits), independent or hands-on corroboration of embedded deployments.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers

citations.quote: Embed Zapier's automation capabilities directly into your product so users can connect apps and run automations under your brand.
Bring Zapier’s automation into your own product so customers can build workflows and run actions without leaving your app.
Use Zapier's Workflow API and 9,000 integrations to power a built-in automation experience, integration marketplace, or AI workflows.
